title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Tech-led rally, breadth thinned. QQQ +1.16% outpaced IWM +0.26% as AI capex headlines drove chip sentiment while CPI in line kept September hike odds at 34.7%.

INDICES — VIX 14.6, near 52wk low 13.5. QQQ +1.16%, SOXX +0.76%, SPY +0.70%, DIA +0.14%, IWM +0.26%. Large > small by 0.70pp. TLT +0.58%, USO -1.78%.

VOLUME — SPY at 0.7x, QQQ 0.8x, both below average — low-conviction rally. XLRE at 1.1x with price up = accumulation. GLD 1.1x with price down = distribution in gold.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLC +2.07%, XLRE +1.42%, XLP +1.08%, XLK +1.01%, XLF +0.59%, XLY +0.48%, XLU +0.46%, XLE +0.05%, XLV -0.04%, XLI -0.05%, XLB -0.51%. Top: DRAM +3.89%, IGV +3.10%. Bottom: GDX -2.96%, WGMI -4.00%. Money into tech/comms and real estate, out of materials and miners. Label: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — QQQ PCR 1.12 elevated; SPY PCR 0.98. SPY skew +3.4%, QQQ +4.2% — put premium priced. GEX flip 780 vs SPY spot ~higher; QQQ flip 735. VIX 14.6 below 20-day 16.9 — complacency despite protection demand.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold -1.47% and silver -1.52% fell despite risk-off in metals, diverging from TLT +0.58% bond bid — metals profit-taking over macro hedge. Oil -1.78% with OVX down to 49.4 signals fading geopolitical premium.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Greed 63.1/100. WDAY +17.78% on Silver Lake bid report, 3.7x vol — accumulation. PAAS -9.70% with no catalyst, 2.5x vol — distribution; KWEB -2.51% at 2.1x vol. Watch XLB -0.51% against DRAM +3.89% divergence; GLD -1.47% near 343 gamma flip; XLC +2.07% with 20-day -0.09% trend break.
